items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: took the Alabam--Will Heflin and I--after Mosby and everything left.

ctx.x: Yeah, the Lincoln. Then I moved down and went over to...took the Alabam--Will Heflin and I--after Mosby and everything left.
Well did [Curtis] Mosby actually own it, or did he only operate it? Somebody told me...
